name: Food
title: Ada's Kitchen: how a food business runs on Taskiem
blurb: One working day at Ada's Kitchen in Yaba, Lagos: the morning briefing, lunch orders on WhatsApp, a rider with a cool box, a rice run to the mill, a party-pack deal with a canteen, and the day's money, all run alongside the chats Ada already has with her customers and suppliers. Episode 0 shows the whole day; Episodes 1 to 10 teach each part.
card_sub: A working day at Ada's Kitchen: orders, riders, stock and deals.
cta_sub: Taskiem works alongside your chats: orders, stock, money and staff, taken care of.
